prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production eight-pose transparent sprite sheet for the adult desktop companion DESIGNER.
Reference 1 is canonical character identity; reference 2 shows her existing sprite poses. Draw ONLY the same adult designer eight times, exact 4 columns by 2 rows.
Her appearance: adult pink-haired artist with asymmetrical swept bangs, high loose bun and one long thick pink braid ending in a teal fabric bow; rose eyes, small silver earrings, dark fitted long-sleeve turtleneck and wide flowing black ankle-length culotte trousers; asymmetrical cream drawing apron with pink brush stains and diagonal pointed hem, dusty rose waist tie, white-and-rose block-heel ankle boots, small hanging tool pouch. Preserve her attractive ADULT proportions, normal anatomy and dimensional shaded fabric. Her braid rests over her own right shoulder and the asymmetrical apron/tool pouch stay on their physical side; do not horizontally mirror references.
Top row:
1 TRUE RIGHT-facing three-quarter work view — nose points RIGHT, torso rotated RIGHT, drawing with stylus on a handheld tablet toward the RIGHT of her torso; NOT left-looking or front looking.
2 TRUE RIGHT-facing exact profile — nose points RIGHT, visible side silhouette, draw stylus/tablet in front of the RIGHT-facing body.
3 ENTIRELY BACK-facing standing, back of bun, braid and apron straps shown, holding tablet in front, face invisible.
4 walking LEFT, tablet tucked under arm, opposite arm swinging naturally, one leg forward.
Bottom row:
5 walking RIGHT, independently drawn opposite stride, preserve costume and braid physical side.
6 kneeling on ONE knee drawing with stylus on tablet, clear bent legs under trousers, both boots visible.
7 leaning one forearm on a compact minimal drawing desk, stylus/tablet work, relaxed but active, full legs and feet.
8 seated at a compact minimal desk working on tablet with stylus, stool and both boots complete.
Arrange figures evenly in eight large isolated cells with wide true transparent gutters. Complete hair, hands, tablet, apron tips, bow, furniture and boots never touch cell edges or canvas edge. Keep consistent physical head size in all eight poses; crouched and seated bodies should be shorter rather than scaled up.
Detailed crisp pixel-art illustration, same visual style, realistic material highlights to convey volume. True transparent RGBA backdrop, no gradient background, no floor or shadows outside sprite, NO red/yellow/green outline fringe, no glow, no colored matte. No labels, letters, numbers, borders, divider lines, logos or watermarks. No extra objects beyond drawing tools and minimal required furniture.
